Name: Enlarge/Reduce
Components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered iron)
Description: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, they can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell has no effect. If the target is a creature, everything they are wearing and carrying changes size with them. Any item dropped by an affected creature returns to normal size at once. Enlarge The target’s size doubles in all dimensions, and its weight is multiplied by eight. This effect increases its size by one category (from Medium to Large, for example). If there isn’t enough room for the target to double its size, the creature or object attains the maximum possible size in the space available. Until the spell ends, the target has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s weapons also grow to match its new size, and while these weapons are enlarged, the target’s attacks with them deal 1d4 extra damage. Reduce The target’s size is halved in all dimensions, and its weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This reduction decreases its size by one category (from Medium to Small, for example). Until the spell ends, the target has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. The target’s weapons also shrink to match its new size, and while these weapons are reduced, the target’s attacks with them deal 1d4 less damage (this can’t reduce the damage below 1).
At Higher Levels: When casting this spell at a higher level than 3rd, you can choose to apply whichever effect below (enlarge or reduce) you picked when casting the spell an additional time for every two slot levels above 2nd (4th, 6th and 8th). If you do, it yields the following effects: Enlarge. The creature’s dimensions double, their resulting weight is multiplied by eight again, and they increase another size category (if possible). The creature’s weapons and equipment grow with them, and for each size category they increase by, their attacks deal 1d4 additional damage. Reduce. The creature’s size is reduced by half again, its weight reduced to one-eighth of its resulting weight, and they decrease by one size category. This effect can only be applied enough to reduce a creature to Tiny, then has no further effect. For each size category they are reduced by, their attacks deal 1d4 less damage (minimum 1)
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
